caption: The drawing shows an ornamental object composed of a pedestal-like base supporting an intricately decorated bowl or vessel. The base is colored in shades of gray with some shadowed areas suggesting depth, and sits on a small square platform with yellow and reddish-brown tones. The upper part of the object, resting on the pedestal, resembles a bowl adorned with circular patterns and dot motifs in grayish hues. Positioned on top of the bowl are two stylized bird figures facing each other, with their beaks almost touching, creating an arch with an oval cut-out between them. The birds have earthy tones of green, orange, yellow, and brown. Nestled next to the birds and partially in front of them is a grouping of rounded, fruit-like forms in various colors including yellow, red, and brown. The entire composition is centered on a pale beige background and is enclosed within a faint rectangular border. The artist's signature appears in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Chalkware Urn with Fruit and Birds
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
